tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool graphite neutrals in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, segmented-control tracks, the app sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders; meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata and units on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Brand dark: the icon ground, social backgrounds, the cover slab. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite-light
tokens.usage: Top of the icon's graphite gradient; secondary brand blocks on social assets.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a graphite fill.

tokens.name: readout
tokens.usage: Odometer digit cells and other instrument-style readouts; stays distinct from surface in dark.

tokens.name: on-readout
tokens.usage: Digits on a readout cell.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand accent and primary action fill: the gauge needle, primary buttons, the fuel quick-add. A fill only; for orange text use orange-text.

tokens.name: orange-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of orange fills.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text and icons (links, active nav, selected tab) on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds behind orange-text: selected rows, the active nav item, chart area fill.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange fill. Always dark, never white.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Status: due soon. As text, on the surfaces and yellow-soft.

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the due-soon badge and banner.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Status: overdue, destructive actions, validation errors. As text, on the surfaces and red-soft.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the overdue badge and error banners.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1: the selected vehicle or the primary measure.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing headlines and the empty garage. Set with font-variation-settings 'wdth' 125 (the ax-display class).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop. ax-display class (wdth 125).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Vehicle names, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page and card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Replaced front pads and rotors; rotors were under minimum thickness.
styles.usage: Default text: record notes, descriptions, form copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, stat labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The odometer readout and hero stats.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every user-entered number in tables and lists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; the page gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Odometer digit cells, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Glass panels and marketing cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Optional: cards also carry a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels: the vehicle hero card, marketing cards. Top rim highlight plus a long soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the mobile quick-add sheet.
